I’m sorry you’re dealing with that—I'm here to help. First, I’ll need to authenticate your account so I can look up your orders.

Please share **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name, last name, and ZIP code**

- list all of your recent orders (with which items were ordered and whether they’re **pending/processed/delivered**), and then
- help you cancel the ones that haven’t arrived yet and set up returns for the delivered ones (after you confirm the exact actions).

Thank you, I really appreciate your understanding. I’ll give you my email address to make it easier: silva7872@example.com.

Let me know if you need anything else to pull up my account. I just want to make sure I handle everything correctly, since things have been a bit chaotic for me lately.
